title: Life of Pompey (Parallel Lives)
author: Plutarch
note: Key classical biographical source, written ~150 years after events. Moralizing but detailed. Needs edition/translation reference.

title: Civil Wars (Bellum Civile)
author: Appian
note: Detailed military narrative of late Republic civil wars. 2nd century CE. Needs edition/translation reference.

title: Roman History
author: Cassius Dio
note: Books 36-42 cover Pompey's prime years. 3rd century CE. Needs edition/translation reference.

title: Commentarii de Bello Civili (Civil War)
author: Julius Caesar
note: First-person account by Caesar of the civil war. Obviously biased (pro-Caesar). Primary source for 49-48 BCE.

note: Authoritative reference on late Republic. Needs exact page references.
